niche: remote human observation and documentation support for practice practice workflows
style_prompt: Premium calm security operations scene. Midnight navy, warm ivory, safety amber, and signal teal. Realistic dimensional lighting with a distinct visual structure.
negative_prompt: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks. Keep the left 55 percent relatively clear for editorial typography.
